{{Top|leg}}
'''Hypermatter science''' was a field of science that involved the study of [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]]. During the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] developed an interest in the development of [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar's]] proposed [[Expeditionary Battle Planetoid]] and he appointed the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Bevel Lemelisk]] to pursue the advances in hypermatter science that would be necessary to make the scheme a reality.
